/bin/bash -lc "python - <<'PY'
import json
from work import evaluate

base = {
    'defaults': {'enabled': True, 'retries': 3, 'label': 'job'},
    'types': {'enabled': 'boolean', 'retries': 'integer', 'label': 'string'},
    'null_resets': True,
    'environment': True,
}
checks = [
    ({'layers': [{'enabled': False}, {'retries': 0}, {'label': ''}]}, {'ok': True, 'config': {'enabled': False, 'retries': 0, 'label': ''}, 'error': None}),
    ({'layers': [{'retries': 8}, {'retries': None}]}, {'ok': True, 'config': {'enabled': True, 'retries': 3, 'label': 'job'}, 'error': None}),
    ({'layers': [{'extra': 1}]}, {'ok': False, 'config': {}, 'error': 'unknown_key'}),
    ({'layers': [{'retries': True}]}, {'ok': False, 'config': {}, 'error': 'type'}),
    ({'layers': [], 'environment': {'enabled': 'false', 'retries': '+02', 'label': ''}}, {'ok': True, 'config': {'enabled': False, 'retries': 2, 'label': ''}, 'error': None}),
]
for request, expected in checks:
    actual = evaluate(request, base)
    assert actual == expected, (request, actual, expected)
for invalid in ['TRUE', 'False', '1', '', ' true']:
    assert evaluate({'environment': {'enabled': invalid}}, base)['error'] == 'environment'
for invalid in ['1.0', ' 1', '1 ', '--1', '']:
    assert evaluate({'environment': {'retries': invalid}}, base)['error'] == 'environment'
print('all assertions passed')
PY"
